title: Word Counter & Character Counter — Count Everything in Your Text

content.intro: Word count is the starting point for every piece of writing. Craftisle's free Text Counter goes beyond simple counting — it tracks characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading time, keyword density, and more, all in real-time.

sections.heading: Everything We Count
sections.body: Words: the total number of words. Characters (with spaces): includes all characters. Characters (without spaces): excludes whitespace. Sentences: counted by end punctuation (!.?). Paragraphs: counted by line breaks. Reading time: estimated at 238 words per minute (average adult). Speaking time: estimated at 130 words per minute. Pages: estimated at 500 words per page (single-spaced).

sections.heading: SEO Writing with Word Count
sections.body: Google prefers comprehensive content — most top-ranking pages are 1,500-2,500 words. But quality > quantity. Use our counter to hit minimums (300 words to avoid 'thin content' flags) and check if your content is competitive in length for its topic.

sections.heading: Social Media Character Limits
sections.body: Twitter/X: 280 characters. LinkedIn: 3,000 characters for posts, 700 for company page updates. Instagram captions: 2,200 characters (truncated after 125). Meta descriptions: 155-160 characters. Our counter helps you stay within limits.

sections.heading: How to Use the Text Counter
sections.body: Paste or type your text. All counts update in real-time. Keyword density shows the most-used words and their frequency. Char/word/line stats appear in a compact sidebar. No signup, no limits — just paste and count.

content.conclusion: Whether you're writing a tweet, a blog post, or a thesis, word count matters. Craftisle's free Text Counter gives you all the metrics you need in one clean, real-time interface.

keyTakeaways: Text Counter provides real-time character, word, sentence, and paragraph counts.
Supports multiple languages including Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
Useful for social media character limits (Twitter, Instagram, etc.).
Export statistics as JSON or copy to clipboard.
100% free, no ads, works offline after first load.
